Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-present a short joint demo for the GCP Marketplace listing. Goal is a 40-minute customer-facing demo (product + joint value prop) + 10–15 minutes for Q&A. We also like to run a quick 25-minute tech run with your SA beforehand to align on environment, screen sharing, and any sensitive data notes.

Proposed demo slots (all PT):
- Tue Nov 30 — 10:30–11:20 PT (1:30–2:20 ET)
- Wed Dec 1 — 08:00–08:50 PT (11:00–11:50 ET)
- Thu Dec 2 — 15:00–15:50 PT (18:00–18:50 ET)

If none of those work we can push to the following week. For the tech run, we suggest 30 minutes before the demo (25 minutes dry-run + 5 minutes host checks).

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook-v1.pdf (run-of-show & roles). I'll share the working deck link once we lock time.

Can you confirm:
1) Preferred demo slot (or suggest alternatives)
2) Who from Stratus will join as the Solutions Architect / technical lead
3) Any restrictions on recording or materials we should know about

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

—
